tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find local businesses in one city and one category, with their contacts, what Veezco measured on their website and an opening line for the call. Each NEW lead costs 1 Veezco credit; leads you already received are free and come first. Categories are written as Veezco stores them: Italian plural names

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the business categories Veezco already collected in a city, with the date of the latest collection. Free, no credits used. Use it to pick the exact category name for search_companies.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Your Veezco credit balance and plan. Free, no credits used. One credit is one new lead.
